text_markup: When swapping installed cards, any cards or counters hosted on either of the swapped cards maintain their hosting relationships.
text_plain: When swapping installed cards, any cards or counters hosted on either of the swapped cards maintain their hosting relationships.

examples.text_markup: The Corp uses {card:Thimblerig}'s ability to swap it with a {card:Palisade} hosting {card:Botulus}. The {card:Botulus} remains hosted on the {card:Palisade} throughout this process.
examples.text_plain: The Corp uses Thimblerig's ability to swap it with a Palisade hosting Botulus. The Botulus remains hosted on the Palisade throughout this process.
